verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is a developer-first background jobs/workflow orchestration platform where workflows are authored as TypeScript code, not via a natural-language prompt interface for generating/editing workflows. The evidence shows AI assistant integration (MCP server, skills, docs search) to help developers code tasks, but nothing lets an end user generate or edit a workflow purely from a natural-language prompt. missing for 10: any UI or feature for prompt-driven workflow generation/editing, evidence of NL-to-workflow translation, or a no-code prompt-based builder.
